verdict.rationale: Letta explicitly documents a local-first mode: 'default local mode stores agent state on your machine and does not require a Letta login' and self-hosted deployments where 'all agent state, including messages, memory, and provider connections, stays on-device, and no Letta account is required,' plus 'Letta agents can run entirely on infrastructure you control' via the self-hosted App Server. It's also model-agnostic, allowing swapping underlying models. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of running against local/self-hosted LLM backends (e.g., Ollama or local inference servers) rather than just cloud model providers, and independent/hands-on corroboration of a fully offline embedded deployment.
